# WebLuxe Cars

> Used car dealer at 24 Royal Road, Phoenix, Mauritius. Buy, sell or exchange a car; leasing through Sample Leasing Co. Prices are in Mauritian rupees.

- Phone: 5123 4567

- Email: sales@webluxecars.mu
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9:00 to 17:00, Saturday 9:00 to 16:00, closed Sunday
